instruction: Move any files changed within the last week from '/tmp/test_files/source' to '/tmp/test_files/recent'.

parameters.command: mkdir -p /tmp/test_files/source /tmp/test_files/recent && touch /tmp/test_files/source/new_file1.txt /tmp/test_files/source/new_file2.log /tmp/test_files/source/old_file1.txt /tmp/test_files/source/old_file2.txt && find /tmp/test_files/source -name 'new_file*' -exec touch -d '5 days ago' {} \; && find /tmp/test_files/source -name 'old_file*' -exec touch -d '20 days ago' {} \;

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'alt', 't'); time.sleep(0.5)

result.command: bash -c 'BASE_DIR="/tmp/test_files"; RECENT_FILES_MOVED=false; recent_count=$(find "$BASE_DIR/recent" -type f 2>/dev/null | wc -l); if [ "$recent_count" -ge 2 ]; then RECENT_FILES_MOVED=true; fi; OLD_FILES_KEPT=false; old_count=$(find "$BASE_DIR/source" -type f 2>/dev/null | wc -l); if [ "$old_count" -ge 2 ]; then OLD_FILES_KEPT=true; fi; if $RECENT_FILES_MOVED && $OLD_FILES_KEPT; then echo "Success: The task was completed correctly."; else echo "Failure: The task was not completed correctly."; fi'

include: Success: The task was completed correctly.

metadata.explanation: Task variation that requires moving files modified within last 7 days to a different directory. Setup creates source directory with new_file* (modified 5 days ago) and old_file* (modified 20 days ago). Evaluator verifies new files are in /recent directory and old files remain in /source directory.
metadata.verification_details: The evaluation checks: (1) at least 2 files exist in /tmp/test_files/recent (the moved files), (2) at least 2 files remain in /tmp/test_files/source (the old files that shouldn't be moved). This ensures the agent correctly identified files by modification date and moved only recent ones.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirements by checking both moved and retained files
The bash script logic correctly requires at least 2 files in /recent (the 2 new_file* modified 5 days ago) AND at least 2 files in /source (the 2 old_file* modified 20 days ago)
This logic correctly handles all edge cases: moving all files would fail (0 in source), moving none would fail (0 in recent), moving only some would fail (count < 2 in one directory)
The check_include_exclude metric correctly verifies the success message is included in the command output
Complete coverage: evaluator checks both aspects of the instruction (files moved AND files kept based on modification date)
